title: How is Neymar connected to Queen Elizabeth II?
description:
Three real photos link Neymar to Queen Elizabeth II, by way of a Brazilian president and a future king.

Neymar → Jair Bolsonaro → Charles III → Elizabeth II

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Neymar → Jair Bolsonaro: In July 2019, at the Copa América final in Rio, Neymar posed with Brazil's president Jair Bolsonaro.
   Photo by Palácio do Planalto, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2019_Final_da_Copa_Am%C3%A9rica_2019_-_48225217491.jpg
2. Jair Bolsonaro → King Charles III: That October in Tokyo, Bolsonaro met Prince Charles; both had come for Japan's new emperor's enthronement ceremony.
   Photo by Palácio do Planalto, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2019_Reuni%C3%A3o_Bilateral_com_o_Pr%C3%ADncipe_Charles_-_48947648318.jpg
3. King Charles III → Queen Elizabeth II: And in 2022, Charles stood beside his mother, Queen Elizabeth the Second, for her Platinum Jubilee on the palace balcony.
   Photo by Number 10, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Queen_Elizabeth_II_Platinum_Jubilee_2022_-_Platinum_Pageant_(52123563502).jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
